canonical_w3.budget: declared sweep budget; the schedule is budgeted, its termination at this rung is work in progress

historical_L6.comparison_limit: Historical L6 uses a different regulator, preparation, schedule and budget; matched L3-L5 controls are supplied separately. Integer nearest agreement is never the provenance law.

interpretation.confluence: Each component has one fixed point at its preserved mean. Repetition of a finite sweep containing every seam converges to it. The four-sweep endpoints remain schedule dependent; no finite exact termination is claimed.
interpretation.growth: Raw interval counts against phase gaps and longest-chain height, plus successive ratios. Neither is a physical clock or a fitted continuum dimension.
interpretation.kernels: Expectation-operator all-port probes, not the response of the particular phase history. Four declared cells per glued wiring; extrema cover only those samples.
interpretation.paired_gap: The two routes use different laws, event granularities, preparations and clocks. The measured contrast does not isolate wiring as the sole cause, and is not a derivation of the record-metric read law.
interpretation.positions: Each interval has both coordinate placements. Coordinates select anchors and annotate events; the authenticated order and its counts do not change when a fixed interval is replotted.
interpretation.q13_boundary: The lag-four q13 interval is clipped. Its approximately 4.15 estimate must not be labelled an interior-diamond result. Lags one through three are retained with their interior flags.
